examples.target: 很多人會去林村許願樹祈求好運。

examples.source: If you visit the Lam Tsuen Wishing Trees, you can write down your wishes.
examples.target: 如果你去林村許願樹，你可以寫下你的願望。

examples.source: The dust on the lampshade makes the room look very dirty.
examples.target: 燈罩上的灰塵令房間看起來很髒。

examples.source: Please be careful when you clean the glass lampshade.
examples.target: 清潔玻璃燈罩時，請務必小心。

examples.source: I bought a new lampshade because the old one was broken.
examples.target: 我買了一個新燈罩，因為舊的那個壞了。

landfill site.meaning: 堆填區 / 垃圾堆填場

examples.source: The city sends all its waste to the landfill site.
examples.target: 這座城市把所有廢物都送到堆填區。

examples.source: We should recycle more to reduce waste at the landfill site.
examples.target: 我們應該多做回收，以減少堆填區的垃圾。

examples.source: The landfill site is almost full because we produce too much trash.
examples.target: 因為我們製造太多垃圾，堆填區快要滿了。

examples.source: The spaceship found a safe landing site on the moon.
examples.target: 太空船在月球上找到了一個安全的降落地點。

examples.source: We chose this flat area as our landing site.
examples.target: 我們選擇了這片平坦的區域作為降落地點。

examples.source: The pilot looked for a clear landing site when landing.
examples.target: 飛行員在降落時尋找一個清晰的降落地點。

examples.source: Please call me on my landline if I am at home.
examples.target: 如果我在家，請打我的固定電話找我。

examples.source: Many people do not use a landline at home anymore.
examples.target: 現在很多人在家裡都不再使用座機了。

examples.source: I could not find the number for the office landline.
examples.target: 我找不到辦公室固定電話的號碼。

examples.source: The heavy rain caused a landslip on the hillside today.
examples.target: 今天的大雨導致山坡發生了山泥傾瀉。

examples.source: We must stay away from slopes during a landslip warning.
examples.target: 山泥傾瀉警告生效時，我們必須遠離斜坡。

examples.source: A small landslip blocked the road after the storm passed.
examples.target: 風暴過後，一次小規模的山泥傾瀉堵塞了道路。

examples.source: My friend loves eating traditional Laotian food for dinner.
examples.target: 我朋友晚餐很喜歡吃傳統的老撾菜。

examples.source: We learned about Laotian culture during our geography lesson today.
examples.target: 我們在今天的地理課上學習了老撾文化。

examples.source: She bought a beautiful scarf from a Laotian market.
examples.target: 她從一個老撾市場買了一條漂亮的圍巾。

examples.source: My best friend is a Laotian who loves cooking spicy food.
examples.target: 我最好的朋友是一位喜歡煮辣味食物的老撾人。

examples.source: We met a friendly Laotian when we visited the night market.
examples.target: 我們參觀夜市時，遇到了一位友善的老撾人。

examples.source: The Laotian showed us how to make traditional crafts in class.
examples.target: 那位老撾人在課堂上向我們展示如何製作傳統手工藝。

examples.source: My mother makes delicious lasagne for us every Sunday night.
examples.target: 我媽媽每個星期日晚上都會為我們做美味的意式千層麵。

examples.source: I love eating lasagne because it has a lot of cheese.
examples.target: 我喜歡吃意式千層麵，因為它有很多芝士。

examples.source: If you are hungry, we can share a large lasagne together.
examples.target: 如果你餓的話，我們可以一起分享一份大份的意式千層麵。

last-minute.meaning: 最後一刻的 / 臨急的

examples.source: I had to finish my last-minute homework before school started.
examples.target: 我必須在上課前完成最後一刻才做的功課。

examples.source: We made a last-minute decision to go to the park.
examples.target: 我們在最後一刻決定去公園。

examples.source: Don't make last-minute changes to your project presentation.
examples.target: 不要在最後一刻才更改你的專題報告。

examples.source: His laziness caused him to hand in the homework late.
examples.target: 他的懶惰令他遲交功課。

examples.source: You will not succeed if you let laziness control you.
examples.target: 如果你任由懶惰控制自己，你是不會成功的。

examples.source: She missed the deadline because of her laziness.
examples.target: 她因為懶惰而錯過了限期。

examples.source: You can leave it to me if you are busy.
examples.target: 如果你很忙，可以交給我處理。

examples.source: Please leave it to the teacher to decide the date.
examples.target: 請交給老師決定日期。

examples.source: I will leave it to my brother when I go out.
examples.target: 我外出時會交給哥哥處理。

examples.source: The puppy refused to leave my side during our long walk.
examples.target: 在我們漫長的散步過程中，這隻小狗不願離開我的身邊。

examples.source: Please do not leave my side when we are in the crowd.
examples.target: 當我們在人群中時，請不要離開我的身邊。

examples.source: She promised never to leave his side if he felt scared.
examples.target: 她答應如果他感到害怕，就絕不會離開他的身邊。

examples.source: The cat let out a loud cry when it saw the dog.
examples.target: 當貓咪看到狗的時候，牠發出了一聲大叫。

examples.source: She let out a sigh of relief after finishing her homework.
examples.target: 做完功課後，她鬆了一口氣。

examples.source: The boy let out a laugh because the joke was funny.
examples.target: 因為那個笑話很有趣，男孩忍不住笑了出來。

examples.source: I promise I will not let you down this time.
examples.target: 我保證這次絕對不會令你失望。

examples.source: He felt sad because he let his parents down.
examples.target: 他感到很難過，因為他令父母失望了。

examples.source: If you do not study, you will let yourself down.
examples.target: 如果你不努力讀書，你會令自己失望。

live life to the fullest.meaning: 盡情生活 / 充實地生活

examples.source: You should live life to the fullest every single day.
examples.target: 你每一天都應該盡情生活。

examples.source: She wants to live life to the fullest when she travels.
examples.target: 她去旅行時，想盡情享受生活。

examples.source: If you live life to the fullest, you will be happy.
examples.target: 如果你能充實地生活，你就會感到快樂。

examples.source: Many small animals live on seeds and nuts in winter.
examples.target: 冬天時，許多小動物都靠種子和堅果維生。

examples.source: Some students live on a small budget each month.
examples.target: 有些學生每個月靠有限的預算生活。

examples.source: Some people live on rice and vegetables in this village.
examples.target: 在這個村莊裡，有些人只靠米飯和蔬菜維生。

live on one's own.meaning: 獨自生活 / 自己生活

examples.source: I want to live on my own when I go to university.
examples.target: 當我上大學時，我想獨自生活。

examples.source: It is difficult to live on your own for the first time.
examples.target: 第一次獨自生活是很困難的。

examples.source: He learned how to cook because he had to live on his own.
examples.target: 因為他必須獨自生活，所以他學會了烹飪。

examples.source: It is interesting to look back at my childhood photos.
examples.target: 回顧我童年的照片是一件很有趣的事。

examples.source: When I look back, I realize I learned a lot.
examples.target: 當我回顧過去時，我發現自己學到了很多。

examples.source: We like to look back on our school memories together.
examples.target: 我們喜歡一起回顧我們的校園回憶。

examples.source: It is interesting to look back at my old photos.
examples.target: 回顧我以前的照片是一件很有趣的事。

examples.source: We often look back at our primary school memories.
examples.target: 我們經常回顧小學時期的回憶。

examples.source: When I look back at last year, I feel proud.
examples.target: 當我回顧去年時，我感到很自豪。

examples.source: Please look down at your book when you read the words.
examples.target: 當你讀這些字的時候，請向下看你的書。

examples.source: You should never look down on others because of their grades.
examples.target: 你不應該因為成績而看不起其他人。

examples.source: I had to look down to tie my loose shoelaces carefully.
examples.target: 我必須向下看，小心地綁好鬆脫的鞋帶。

examples.source: Please look out for my brother when you are at school.
examples.target: 當你在學校時，請幫我留意一下我弟弟。

examples.source: You should look out for cars when you cross the road.
examples.target: 過馬路的時候，你應該要留心尋找來往的車輛。

examples.source: We need to look out for the signs on the trail.
examples.target: 我們需要留意山徑上的路標。

examples.source: I really look up to my brother because he is kind.
examples.target: 我真的很尊敬我的哥哥，因為他為人友善。

examples.source: Students look up to teachers who are patient and helpful.
examples.target: 學生會仰慕那些既有耐性又樂於助人的老師。

examples.source: She looks up to her mother for working so hard daily.
examples.target: 她很尊敬她的母親，因為她每天都工作得很辛苦。

examples.source: I always lose my appetite when the weather is too hot.
examples.target: 天氣太熱的時候，我總是會失去胃口。

examples.source: He lost his appetite because he felt very nervous before exams.
examples.target: 因為考試前感到很緊張，他失去了胃口。

examples.source: If you are sick, you might lose your appetite for food.
examples.target: 如果你生病了，你可能會失去胃口。

examples.source: Lebanon is a beautiful country located by the Mediterranean Sea.
examples.target: 黎巴嫩是一個位於地中海旁邊的美麗國家。

examples.source: My friend moved to Lebanon when he was ten years old.
examples.target: 我朋友十歲的時候搬到了黎巴嫩居住。

examples.source: We learned about the history of Lebanon in our geography class.
examples.target: 我們在地理課上學習了關於黎巴嫩的歷史。

examples.source: The university lecturer explained the lesson clearly to all students.
examples.target: 大學講師向所有學生清晰地講解了課堂內容。

examples.source: I want to be a lecturer when I grow up.
examples.target: 我長大後想成為一名講師。

examples.source: If you have questions, please ask your lecturer after class.
examples.target: 如果你有問題，請在課後詢問你的講師。

examples.source: I like to add fresh lemongrass to my chicken soup.
examples.target: 我喜歡在雞湯裡加入新鮮的香茅。

examples.source: Lemongrass gives this Thai curry a very refreshing scent.
examples.target: 香茅令這款泰式咖哩有一種很清新的香氣。

examples.source: You can use lemongrass to make a fragrant herbal tea.
examples.target: 你可以用香茅來泡製帶有香氣的香草茶。

examples.source: The librarian helped me find a book for my project.
examples.target: 圖書館管理員幫我找到一本專題研習用的書。

examples.source: You should ask the librarian if you cannot find the book.
examples.target: 如果你找不到那本書，可以詢問圖書館管理員。

examples.source: The librarian asked us to be quiet in the library.
examples.target: 圖書館管理員提醒我們在圖書館內保持安靜。

examples.source: Moving to a new city was a life-changing experience for me.
examples.target: 搬到新城市居住，對我來說是一次改變人生的經歷。

examples.source: Winning the competition was a life-changing moment for the young student.
examples.target: 贏得比賽對這位年輕學生來說，是一個改變人生的時刻。

examples.source: Reading this book had a life-changing effect on my daily habits.
examples.target: 閱讀這本書對我的日常生活習慣產生了改變人生的影響。

life-size.meaning: 真人大小的 / 實物大小的

examples.source: The museum has a life-size model of a dinosaur.
examples.target: 博物館裡有一個恐龍的實物大小模型。

examples.source: I bought a life-size cardboard cutout of my favorite singer.
examples.target: 我買了一個我最愛歌手的真人大小紙板人像。

examples.source: They built a life-size statue to honor the famous hero.
examples.target: 他們建造了一座真人大小的雕像來紀念這位英雄。

examples.source: The sailors lowered the lifeboat into the water during the drill.
examples.target: 船員在演習期間將救生艇降落到水中。

examples.source: Everyone must know how to use a lifeboat in an emergency.
examples.target: 每個人都必須知道如何在緊急情況下使用救生艇。

examples.source: During the safety lesson, we learned how to board a lifeboat.
examples.target: 在安全課堂中，我們學習了如何登上救生艇。

examples.source: The lighthouse helps ships find their way at night.
examples.target: 燈塔幫助船隻在晚間找到方向。

examples.source: We visited the old lighthouse when we went to the island.
examples.target: 我們去離島的時候參觀了那座舊燈塔。

examples.source: The lighthouse shines a bright light across the dark sea.
examples.target: 燈塔向漆黑的海面射出明亮的光芒。

examples.source: She touched the baby's face lightly while he was sleeping.
examples.target: 當嬰兒睡覺時，她輕輕地觸摸了他的臉。

examples.source: Do not take this important decision lightly if you want success.
examples.target: 如果你想成功，就不要輕率地對待這個重要的決定。

examples.source: The snow fell lightly on the ground during the cold night.
examples.target: 在寒冷的夜晚，雪花輕輕地落在地上。

examples.source: This laptop is very lightweight, so I carry it to school.
examples.target: 這部手提電腦很輕身，所以我會帶它回學校。

examples.source: I bought a lightweight jacket because the weather is getting warmer.
examples.target: 因為天氣開始變暖，我買了一件輕便的外套。

examples.source: These shoes are lightweight and comfortable for long walks in summer.
examples.target: 這些鞋子很輕便，夏天長時間走路穿著很舒服。

examples.source: She put a white lily in a vase on the table.
examples.target: 她把一朵白百合花插在桌上的花瓶裡。

examples.source: The garden smells sweet because there are many lilies blooming.
examples.target: 因為花園裡開滿了百合花，所以聞起來很香。

examples.source: If you like simple flowers, you will love the white lily.
examples.target: 如果你喜歡簡約的花，你會愛上白百合。

examples.source: She put on some red lipstick before going to the party.
examples.target: 她在去派對之前塗了一些紅色唇膏。

examples.source: I cannot find my favorite lipstick in my school bag.
examples.target: 我在書包裡找不到我最喜歡的那支唇膏。

examples.source: Please do not borrow my lipstick because it is not clean.
examples.target: 請不要借用我的唇膏，因為它不太乾淨。

lit-up.meaning: 亮起燈的 / 燈火通明的

examples.source: The city looks beautiful with all the lit-up buildings at night.
examples.target: 晚上的城市因為那些燈火通明的建築物而顯得非常美麗。

examples.source: We walked along the lit-up path when we visited the park.
examples.target: 我們參觀公園時，沿著那條亮起燈的小徑散步。

examples.source: The Christmas tree was fully lit-up and looked very bright.
examples.target: 聖誕樹已經完全亮起燈，看起來非常耀眼。

livelier.meaning: 更生動的 / 更熱鬧的

examples.source: The party became much livelier when the music started playing.
examples.target: 音樂響起時，派對變得熱鬧多了。

examples.source: This new classroom design makes our lessons feel livelier.
examples.target: 這個新的課室設計讓我們的課堂感覺更生動。

examples.source: The city center is always livelier on Saturday nights.
examples.target: 市中心在星期六晚上總是特別熱鬧。

examples.source: We saw a cute llama at the petting zoo today.
examples.target: 我們今天在親親動物園看到了一隻可愛的羊駝。

examples.source: The llama has thick fur to keep warm in winter.
examples.target: 羊駝有厚厚的毛，可以在冬天保持溫暖。

examples.source: If you visit the farm, you can feed the llama.
examples.target: 如果你去參觀農場，你可以餵飼羊駝。

examples.source: I bought a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery today.
examples.target: 我今天從麵包店買了一條新鮮的麵包。

examples.source: Could you please slice this loaf of bread for breakfast?
examples.target: 你可以幫我把這條麵包切片做早餐嗎？

examples.source: We finished the whole loaf of bread during our picnic.
examples.target: 我們在野餐時吃完了整條麵包。

examples.source: We prefer to buy vegetables that are grown locally.
examples.target: 我們比較喜歡購買在本地種植的蔬菜。

examples.source: Many people enjoy eating at restaurants located locally.
examples.target: 許多人喜歡在當地的餐廳用餐。

examples.source: The shop sells snacks that are made locally in Hong Kong.
examples.target: 這家店售賣在香港本地製造的小食。

examples.source: We finally watched the long-awaited movie at the cinema yesterday.
examples.target: 我們昨天終於在戲院看了那套期待已久的電影。

examples.source: The students were excited about the long-awaited school trip today.
examples.target: 學生們對今天這個期待已久的學校旅行感到非常興奮。

examples.source: Everyone cheered when the long-awaited summer holiday finally started.
examples.target: 當那個期待已久的暑假終於開始時，大家都歡呼起來。

examples.source: It is hard to maintain a long-distance relationship with friends.
examples.target: 要維持一段長途的友誼並不容易。

examples.source: They often make long-distance calls to talk to their family.
examples.target: 他們經常打長途電話與家人聊天。

examples.source: She enjoys long-distance running because it helps her stay fit.
examples.target: 她喜歡長跑，因為這有助於她保持健康。

examples.source: He wears glasses because he has long-sightedness.
examples.target: 因為他有遠視，所以他需要戴眼鏡。

examples.source: The doctor told me that I have mild long-sightedness.
examples.target: 醫生告訴我，我有輕微的遠視。

examples.source: If you have long-sightedness, you may find reading difficult.
examples.target: 如果你有遠視，你可能會覺得閱讀很困難。

examples.source: They finally solved their longstanding problem after a long meeting.
examples.target: 經過一場長會議後，他們終於解決了長期存在的問題。

examples.source: The school has a longstanding tradition of helping the local community.
examples.target: 這所學校有一個長期存在的傳統，就是幫助本地社區。

examples.source: It is a longstanding rule that students must wear their uniforms.
examples.target: 學生必須穿著校服是一項長期存在的規定。

examples.source: I like wearing loose-fitting clothes when I go jogging.
examples.target: 我跑步時喜歡穿著寬鬆的衣服。

examples.source: These loose-fitting trousers are very comfortable for summer.
examples.target: 這條寬鬆的長褲在夏天穿起來很舒適。

examples.source: She bought a loose-fitting dress because it is very breathable.
examples.target: 她買了一條寬鬆的連身裙，因為它非常透氣。

examples.source: Please apply some lotion if your skin feels dry.
examples.target: 如果覺得皮膚乾燥，請塗抹一些潤膚液。

examples.source: She puts on body lotion after every shower.
examples.target: 她每次洗澡後都會塗抹潤膚液。

examples.source: I bought a bottle of lotion for my dry hands.
examples.target: 我買了一瓶潤膚液來護理乾燥的雙手。

examples.source: He is a great lover of classical music and listens daily.
examples.target: 他是古典音樂的愛好者，每天都會聆聽。

examples.source: As a lover of nature, she enjoys hiking in the mountains.
examples.target: 作為一名大自然愛好者，她很喜歡去山上遠足。

examples.source: My brother is a true lover of books and reads constantly.
examples.target: 我哥哥是一位真正的書迷，他經常都在閱讀。

examples.source: The mother looked lovingly at her baby in the crib.
examples.target: 母親充滿愛意地看著嬰兒床裡的寶寶。

examples.source: He lovingly prepared a delicious breakfast for his family.
examples.target: 他充滿愛意地為家人準備了美味的早餐。

examples.source: She held the small kitten lovingly in her arms.
examples.target: 她充滿愛意地把小貓抱在懷裡。

examples.source: I always choose low-calorie snacks when I am hungry.
examples.target: 當我肚餓時，我總是會選擇低卡路里的零食。

examples.source: The menu shows which drinks are low-calorie.
examples.target: 餐牌標示了哪些飲品是低卡路里的。

examples.source: The school canteen added a low-calorie lunch option.
examples.target: 學校飯堂新增了一個低卡路里的午餐選擇。

low-cost.meaning: 低成本的 / 價格低廉的

examples.source: We chose a low-cost airline to save money for our trip.

examples.target: 文章猛烈抨擊浪費開支。

examples.source: The boxes were lashed to the roof of the car.
examples.target: 箱子被用繩綁在車頂上。

examples.source: They lashed the sign to a wooden pole.
examples.target: 他們把標誌用繩綁在木柱上。

examples.source: The boat was lashed to the dock.
examples.target: 小船被用繩綁在碼頭上。

laws on the books.meaning: 現行法律 / 已成文法律

examples.source: There are laws on the books to protect children.
examples.target: 有現行法律保護兒童。

examples.source: The report reviews the laws on the books.
examples.target: 報告檢討已成文法律。

examples.source: Some laws on the books are rarely used.
examples.target: 有些現行法律很少被使用。

lay claim to.meaning: 聲稱擁有 / 可說擁有

examples.source: Several towns lay claim to the old legend.
examples.target: 幾個小鎮都聲稱擁有這個古老傳說。

examples.source: The school can lay claim to a strong music tradition.
examples.target: 學校可說擁有強大的音樂傳統。

examples.source: No one can lay claim to the idea alone.
examples.target: 沒有人可以單獨聲稱擁有這個想法。

examples.source: The teacher lays emphasis on clear examples.
examples.target: 老師重視清晰例子。

examples.source: The school lays emphasis on reading habits.
examples.target: 學校強調閱讀習慣。

examples.source: The article lays emphasis on personal responsibility.
examples.target: 文章強調個人責任。

lay on a treat.meaning: 提供好招待 / 準備精彩活動

examples.source: The school laid on a treat for visiting students.
examples.target: 學校為到訪學生提供好招待。

examples.source: The club laid on a treat after the final lesson.
examples.target: 學會在最後一課後準備精彩活動。

examples.source: Parents laid on a treat for the graduation party.
examples.target: 家長為畢業派對提供好招待。

examples.source: Rainwater leaked into the classroom.
examples.target: 雨水滲入課室。

examples.source: Stress can leak into family life.
examples.target: 壓力會影響到家庭生活。

examples.source: The smell leaked into the corridor.
examples.target: 氣味滲入走廊。

lean into.meaning: 順勢利用 / 積極迎合

examples.source: The speaker leaned into the audience's curiosity.
examples.target: 講者順勢利用觀眾的好奇心。

examples.source: The shop leaned into the summer trend.
examples.target: 店舖積極迎合夏季潮流。

examples.source: She leaned into her strengths during the interview.
examples.target: 她在面試中順勢發揮自己的強項。

examples.source: The athlete leaped in a single bound over the barrier.
examples.target: 運動員一躍而過障礙物。

examples.source: The cat leaped in a single bound onto the table.
examples.target: 貓一躍而上桌子。

examples.source: The hero leaped in a single bound across the gap.
examples.target: 主角一躍而過缺口。

leave a lot to be desired.meaning: 有很多不足 / 未如理想

examples.source: The first draft leaves a lot to be desired.
examples.target: 初稿有很多不足。

examples.source: The service left a lot to be desired.
examples.target: 服務未如理想。

examples.source: His explanation leaves a lot to be desired.
examples.target: 他的解釋有很多不足。

leave someone cold.meaning: 未能打動某人 / 令某人無感

examples.source: The expensive design left me cold.
examples.target: 昂貴的設計未能打動我。

examples.source: The speech left the audience cold.
examples.target: 演說令觀眾無感。

examples.source: That style of music leaves her cold.
examples.target: 那種音樂未能打動她。

leave someone out in the cold.meaning: 冷落某人 / 讓某人得不到幫助

examples.source: The new plan left small shops out in the cold.
examples.target: 新計劃讓小店得不到幫助。

examples.source: Do not leave quiet students out in the cold.
examples.target: 不要冷落安靜的學生。

examples.source: The rule left some families out in the cold.
examples.target: 這條規則讓一些家庭得不到幫助。

examples.source: Colour can leech out of cheap fabric.
examples.target: 便宜布料可能會滲出顏色。

examples.source: Nutrients may leech out of the soil after heavy rain.
examples.target: 大雨後，養分可能從泥土流出。

examples.source: The dye leeched out into the water.
examples.target: 染料滲入水中。

left on the cutting-room floor.meaning: 被剪掉的 / 被刪走的

examples.source: Several scenes were left on the cutting-room floor.
examples.target: 幾個場景被剪掉。

examples.source: Her best joke was left on the cutting-room floor.
examples.target: 她最好的笑話被刪走了。

examples.source: The final article left many details on the cutting-room floor.
examples.target: 最終文章刪走了很多細節。

examples.source: The story lends itself to drama.
examples.target: 這個故事適合改編成戲劇。

examples.source: This topic lends itself to group discussion.
examples.target: 這個題目適合小組討論。

examples.source: The poem lends itself to visual analysis.
examples.target: 這首詩適合用於視覺分析。

let one's emotions run away with one.meaning: 被情緒牽著走 / 讓情緒失控

examples.source: Do not let your emotions run away with you in a debate.
examples.target: 辯論時不要被情緒牽著走。

examples.source: He let his emotions run away with him and shouted.
examples.target: 他讓情緒失控，然後大叫。

examples.source: Taking a breath helps you not let your emotions run away with you.
examples.target: 深呼吸有助你不被情緒牽著走。

let one's hair down.meaning: 放鬆一下 / 盡情輕鬆

examples.source: After exams, students can let their hair down.
examples.target: 考試後，學生可以放鬆一下。

examples.source: She let her hair down at the school party.
examples.target: 她在學校派對中盡情輕鬆。

examples.source: Everyone needs time to let their hair down.
examples.target: 每個人都需要時間放鬆一下。

examples.source: Old machines are liable to break down.
examples.target: 舊機器很可能會壞掉。

examples.source: Without sleep, students are liable to make mistakes.
examples.target: 沒有睡眠，學生容易犯錯。

examples.source: The road is liable to flood after heavy rain.
examples.target: 大雨後，這條路很可能會水浸。

examples.source: No one knew what lay in store for the team.
examples.target: 沒有人知道隊伍即將面對甚麼。

examples.source: Many challenges lie in store this year.
examples.target: 今年有很多挑戰等待著。

examples.source: The opening chapter hints at what lies in store.
examples.target: 開首一章暗示即將發生的事。

light a fire in.meaning: 激起某人的熱情 / 激勵某人

examples.source: The speech lit a fire in the students.
examples.target: 演說激起學生的熱情。

examples.source: A good coach can light a fire in a team.
examples.target: 好教練可以激勵一支隊伍。

examples.source: The book lit a fire in her to write more.
examples.target: 這本書激勵她寫更多。

examples.source: The writer likens the city to a living machine.
examples.target: 作者把城市比作一部有生命的機器。

examples.source: She likened learning grammar to building a house.
examples.target: 她把學文法比作建屋。

examples.source: The article likens the internet to a busy market.
examples.target: 文章把互聯網比作繁忙市場。

examples.source: The study is limited in scope.
examples.target: 這項研究範圍有限。

examples.source: Our project is limited in scope but useful.
examples.target: 我們的項目範圍有限，但很有用。

examples.source: The report is limited in scope to primary schools.
examples.target: 報告範圍限於小學。

line one's pockets.meaning: 中飽私囊 / 私下賺取利益

examples.source: The article accuses officials of lining their pockets.
examples.target: 文章指控官員中飽私囊。

examples.source: Public money should not be used to line someone's pockets.
examples.target: 公帑不應被用來讓某人私下賺取利益。

examples.source: The law aims to stop people from lining their pockets unfairly.
examples.target: 法律旨在阻止人不公平地中飽私囊。

live up to the hype.meaning: 符合宣傳所說 / 不負盛名

examples.source: The new film lived up to the hype.
examples.target: 新電影不負盛名。

examples.source: The product did not live up to the hype.
examples.target: 產品未能符合宣傳所說。

examples.source: Students wondered if the app would live up to the hype.
examples.target: 學生想知道這個應用程式會否不負盛名。

living in sin.meaning: 被視為違反宗教道德地生活

examples.source: The phrase living in sin reflects an old religious judgement.
examples.target: living in sin 這個說法反映舊式宗教道德判斷。

examples.source: The article explains why some people once called the couple living in sin.
examples.target: 文章解釋為何以前有人說那對情侶被視為違反宗教道德地生活。

examples.source: Today, many readers see living in sin as an old-fashioned expression.
examples.target: 今日很多讀者會覺得 living in sin 是過時說法。

examples.source: She was loath to admit her mistake.
examples.target: 她不願意承認自己的錯誤。

examples.source: The manager was loath to cancel the event.
examples.target: 經理不願意取消活動。

examples.source: He is loath to spend money on things he does not need.
examples.target: 他不願意花錢買不需要的東西。

examples.source: Students can lobby for change in school rules.
examples.target: 學生可以游說爭取改變校規。

examples.source: The group lobbied for change after the report.
examples.target: 報告發表後，該團體游說爭取改變。

examples.source: Parents lobbied for change to improve road safety.
examples.target: 家長游說爭取改變，以改善道路安全。

examples.source: The team finally achieved a long-hoped-for victory.
examples.target: 隊伍終於取得期盼已久的勝利。

examples.source: The new library was a long-hoped-for improvement.
examples.target: 新圖書館是大家期盼已久的改善。

examples.source: Her long-hoped-for chance came at last.
examples.target: 她期盼已久的機會終於來了。

examples.source: The lesson helped me look at failure in a new light.
examples.target: 這堂課幫我以新角度看待失敗。

examples.source: After the interview, she looked at the problem in a new light.
examples.target: 訪問後，她以新角度看待這個問題。

examples.source: Reading the poem twice made us look at it in a new light.
examples.target: 讀了兩次詩後，我們以新角度看待它。

look kindly on.meaning: 善意看待 / 願意批准

examples.source: The teacher looked kindly on our honest explanation.
examples.target: 老師善意看待我們誠實的解釋。

examples.source: The committee may look kindly on a careful proposal.
examples.target: 委員會可能願意批准一份周詳的建議。

examples.source: Universities look kindly on students who serve the community.
examples.target: 大學會善意看待服務社區的學生。

examples.source: Some readers look upon the claim with suspicion.
examples.target: 有些讀者以懷疑眼光看待這個說法。

examples.source: The public looked upon the sudden change with suspicion.
examples.target: 公眾以懷疑眼光看待這個突然改變。

examples.source: People may look upon a secret deal with suspicion.
examples.target: 人們可能會以懷疑眼光看待秘密交易。

love for the written word.meaning: 對文字 / 文學的熱愛

examples.source: Her love for the written word began in primary school.
examples.target: 她對文字的熱愛始於小學。

examples.source: The club encourages a love for the written word.
examples.target: 這個學會鼓勵學生培養對文學的熱愛。

examples.source: A love for the written word can improve writing.
examples.target: 對文字的熱愛可以改善寫作。

lower bar to clear.meaning: 較低的要求 / 較易達到的標準

examples.source: The first quiz has a lower bar to clear.
examples.target: 第一個小測有較易達到的標準。

examples.source: For beginners, this course sets a lower bar to clear.
examples.target: 對初學者來說，這課程設定較低的要求。

examples.source: The new rule gives small teams a lower bar to clear.
examples.target: 新規則給小隊伍較易達到的標準。

examples.source: A stranger seemed to lurk about near the gate.
examples.target: 一個陌生人似乎在閘口附近徘徊。

examples.source: Do not lurk about outside the classroom.
examples.target: 不要在課室外面徘徊。

examples.source: The story suggests that danger may lurk about.
examples.target: 故事暗示危險可能在附近潛伏。
